answer: Tankards clink on the tavern shelves and every one was poured in the pewterer's moulds. Proof of pewterer tankard via mould pour count — a tankard the pewterer pours only after 11 tankards run true, each tankard trimmed by the pewterer himself. The relic melts the alloy down to a clean pour. The inlet holds the moulds dusted and ready. The signal racks the finished tankards till they cool. Forging the tally takes 11 tankards poured, 11 tankards trimmed and 11 tankards counted, a morning at the furnace for tankards that still leak at the seam.
